jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Health Coaching
jobs.description:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

Job overview:

The Senior Program Manager, Health Coaching reports to the VP, Operational Excellence and serves as the business operations dyad partner to the Senior Director of Health Coaching & Practice. The Senior Program Manager leads Health Coaching’s strategy and business planning and data driven continuous-improvement efforts. They translate priorities into actionable operating plans, data-driven decisions, and measurable improvements in coach and member outcomes, operating performance, and cost to serve.

The Senior Program Manager proactively partners with stakeholders across Health Coaching, Care Delivery, Clinical, and the broader company to advance business priorities and improve new and existing programs. They bring structure to complex business challenges by using data, performance metrics, and disciplined problem-solving to identify opportunities, clarify tradeoffs, inform decisions, and move cross-functional initiatives forward.

Because this person will influence colleagues within Health Coaching, Care Delivery, and across Omada, they will demonstrate strong leadership skills, operate effectively through ambiguity, and be highly collaborative and organized.

Your Impact:

- Management of strategic roadmap

- Document and manage business priorities, project governance plans, project schedules, success criteria and project milestones

- Develop solutions, identify owners, set delivery/completion dates and set up mechanisms to ensure programs are on track

- Proactively identify and resolve issues that affect Omada’s Care Teams and/or member experience and may impair our ability to meet strategic, programmatic or product goals.

- Actively build relationships across Omada teams to deliver on your roadmap.

- Partner with Care Delivery program managers as well as partners in Clinical, Strategic Finance, Legal, HR, and Engineering/Product/Design to deliver on your roadmap.

- Anticipate bottlenecks, make tradeoffs, balance business needs versus constraints, and provide escalation management as needed.

- Drives programs end-to-end and execute continuous improvement and/or new workflow implementation strategy with minimal to no guidance

- Deeply understands broad business needs and prepares succinct recommendations for tradeoffs to balance business needs versus constraints

- Communication and change management initiatives

- Facilitate decision making and alignment across a broad group of stakeholders.

- Capacity to present well-reasoned and data-driven proposals in both verbal and written form.

- Identify and communicate risks and mitigation plans in collaboration with stakeholders; develop and maintain goals, milestones and completion dates.

- Drive ongoing program improvements based on feedback and performance measurements.

- Utilize strong written and oral communication skills.

- Have the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with extreme discretion.

- Develops materials for Care Team training, knowledge bases, and SOPs independently

- Demonstrated ability to influence change both internally and externally independently

- Sets the standard for authoring business cases and presentation slide decks

- Data analysis

- Analyze data to perform needs and task analysis, scope projects and evaluate existing processes to propose solutions, define areas of focus/opportunity supported by data.

- Identify process and system improvement opportunities by baselining/monitoring existing metrics, analyzing data and partnering with internal teams to positively impact results.

- Develops business insights with custom metrics/attributes without guidance

- Builds business cases for new business metrics and implements them independently

- Creates feedback loops and drives continuous improvement independently

About you:

- Bachelor's degree in a related field

- 10+ years of program management experience

- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements

Bonus Points for:

- MBA or Masters degree in a related field

- PMP or CSM certification

- Healthcare-related certification or license (including health coaching, nutrition/dietetics, exercise science, physical therapy, or practice management)

- Lean or Kaizen certification

Benefits:

- Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus

- Equity grants

- Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)

- Remote first work from home culture

- Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones

- Generous parental leave

- Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)

- 401k retirement savings plan

- Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)

- Mental Health Support Solutions

- ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

- Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.

- Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.

- Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.

- Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.

- Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.

- Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health: Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.

Omada is thrilled to share that we’ve been certified as a Great Place to Work! Please  click here for more information.

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Omada is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Below is a summary of salary ranges, by geographic zone, for this role*. These ranges represent a good faith estimate of the minimum and maximum base salary for the position in that zone at the time of posting. Please refer to this resource for detail on zone designations.

Zone 1: $161,920 - $202,400

Zone 2: $154,880 - $193,600

Zone 3: $140,800 - $176,000

Please note that zones may be updated as market data changes but we will honor the range applicable to your zone (which is determined by your location) as of your application date.

*The actual offer, including the compensation package, will be within the posted range for the relevant zone and will be determined based on multiple factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience, and other business considerations such as internal equity.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Sales and Revenue Operations
jobs.description:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

Job overview:

Omada is looking for a Senior Director of Sales and Revenue Operations to lead and further scale this key function within our organization.This role focuses on every operational aspect of the buyer’s journey by designing, optimizing, and driving performance of the GTM operating system (e.g. data/insights, processes, and technology). The Senior Director of Sales and Revenue Operations oversees a team of operational talent spanning, Sales Operations, Customer Success Operations and channel operations. This is a high impact position in a fast-growing, highly successful organization that offers tremendous room for professional growth. The position reports to the VP of Commercial Operations.

Your Impact:

- Strategic Leadership: Lead the development and execution of Revenue Operations strategy to support and optimize the performance of all customer facing teams including, Employer Sales, Customer Success, Health Plan Sales, and Partnerships. Lead annual roadmap planning and strategic initiatives to scale operations in alignment with company objectives.

- Sales Force and GTM Optimization: Direct the organizational strategies for sales force productivity including quota management, pipeline management, process optimization, and the design and administration of sales compensation plans. Influence decision-making by developing robust forecasting and pipeline management methodologies.

- Process Excellence : Architect a growth-oriented roadmap for process improvement, with system and tool enhancements that provide data-driven insights to advance productivity metrics across our B2B2C customer journey. Champion a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence.

- Collaboration and Influence: Build and maintain influential relationships across Sales, Customer Success, Alliances, and Marketing to ensure cohesive strategy execution. Partner closely with senior leadership to enhance sales processes and facilitate successful rollouts of new initiatives.

- Compensation Strategy Management: Guide effective sales compensation strategies in collaboration with People Operations and Finance, managing the annual sales compensation cycle, compensation committee and governance.

- Cross-functional Integration: Lead Omada’s Commercial roadmap planning planning. Ensure forecasting, and budgeting efforts are harmoniously integrated with broader company processes, driving alignment across departments.

- AI Transformation : Partner cross-functionally to support AI transformation across commercial operations.

- People Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop a Revenue Operations team and culture aligned with Omada values. Serve as a member of the Commercial Operations senior leadership team.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or related field required; Master of Business Administration (MBA) or equivalent preferred.

- 12-15 years of progressive experience in sales operations, revenue operations, or finance, with a focus on optimizing revenue generation activities, preferably in health tech.

- Expertise in sales forecasting, pipeline analysis, and delivering actionable reporting and analytics.

- Proficient in Salesforce products and various sales productivity tools; adept at leveraging technology to enhance sales force efficiency.

- Demonstrated leadership capabilities with a proven track record of building high-performing teams and establishing a culture of accountability and excellence.

- Superior communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior leadership and cross-functional teams.

- Strategic thinker with a strong ability to derive insights from diverse data sources and operational feedback to inform strategic decisions.

- Demonstrated ability to harness curiosity to identify and drive innovative solutions and strategic insights, proactively seeking out new opportunities and challenges to optimize revenue operations and achieve organizational goals.

- Experience preparing and scaling a company towards an IPO is a significant advantage.

- Hands-on management style, capable of navigating complex challenges and driving the organization towards achieving ambitious goals.

Bonus Points for:

- Experience working in a complex B2B2C GTM

- Customer-centric mindset with hands-on sales experience is a plus.

Benefits:

- Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus

- Equity grants

- Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)
